verdict.rationale: The catalog includes what looks like a recent open-weight model (qwen-3.8-27b on the public tier), and a community user says it is "difficult to keep up with the models," which hints at frequent catalog changes. Nothing documents how soon after public release models arrive, and the same thread notes context is limited to 128k for that model. missing for 10: documented time-to-availability after upstream release, a stated policy or track record on onboarding new open-weight models, independent corroboration of day-0 or fast launches, full-spec (e.g., full context) support at launch.
